01_tier_1
Tier 1 / Foundations
Read the wire; build a useful local server.
Mental model
Host = UI, model and permissions. Client = one protocol peer. Server = capabilities and allowed data.
Tools perform operations; resources expose content; prompts provide templates. The host chooses what enters model context.
First run
uv sync; npm ci
uv run python scripts/check_env.py
uv run python scripts/foundation_server.py (waits for protocol input)
npm run inspector -- uv run python scripts/foundation_server.py
Current exchange
Target 2026-07-28. Discover support with server/discover. Every request carries revision and client capabilities in reserved _meta keys.
Match response IDs to request IDs. Notifications have no ID and no response.
A complete tool result may still have isError=true.
Useful primitives
tools/list -> tools/call
resources/list or resources/templates/list -> resources/read
prompts/list -> prompts/get; completion/complete suggests an argument value.
Security habits
Keep stdout exclusively for JSON-RPC; log to stderr.
Validate argument shape and bounds at runtime. Tool annotations are hints, not authorization.
Require a separate review before a write; never let a model grant its own permission.
Checkpoint
uv run python scripts/tier1.py
Explain the request, response, resource URI and approval boundary.
Next: modules 07-10; details in docs/PROTOCOL_GUIDE.md.
02_tier_2
Tier 2 / Real servers
Bound data, work and interactive retries.
Storage
Use fixed SQL and bound parameters. Limit rows and duration.
Keep filesystem reads inside a resolved allowed root; reject symlinks/escape, oversized files and unsupported types.
Use explicit idempotency receipts for safely replayable writes.
Progress and cancellation
Progress uses a request-chosen token. It does not replace a final result.
Propagate cancellation and release work in finally blocks. A timeout does not prove an operation had no effect.
Interactive input
An input_required result embeds elicitation/create requests.
The client asks the person, then retries with a fresh ID, exact requestState and keyed inputResponses.
Bind state to arguments and principal; consume once; expire it. Decline must not mutate data.
HTTP
Use Streamable HTTP. Let the SDK derive matching version, method and name headers.
Bind to 127.0.0.1 by default. Validate Host and exact Origin; configure CORS separately.
Use request-body limits and deadlines. A public service also needs HTTPS and authorization.
Run and inspect
uv run python scripts/tier2.py
uv run python scripts/http_lab.py --help
Capture real messages with scripts/wiretap.py; captures redact credentials.
Checkpoint
Demonstrate read bounds, denied writes, idempotent replay, cancellation cleanup and Origin rejection.
Next: Personal Knowledge capstone and Tier 3.
03_tier_3
Tier 3 / Security and quality
Verify identity; measure behavior.
Authorization
Discover protected-resource metadata, then the configured authorization server.
Check issuer, signature, audience, expiry and scopes. Never fetch keys from a token-supplied URL.
Use PKCE for interactive authorization. Bind stored credentials to the issuer.
Per-call policy
Filter catalogs by verified identity, then check permission again on every call.
Do not forward an incoming token to an upstream API. Obtain separate credentials for that audience.
A model proposal, annotation, registry listing or resource text cannot authorize an operation.
Approval integrity
Review exact tool meaning and exact arguments. Reject changed catalogs.
Use expiring one-use state and independent human approval.
Treat retrieved instructions as data, including hidden instructions in documents.
Evidence
Use synthetic adversarial fixtures. Test denied paths and successful paths.
Separate protocol errors, tool errors, authentication failures and uncertain outcomes.
Redact secrets before logging or saving captures. Keep trace attributes bounded.
Evaluation
An evaluation needs inputs, expected behavior, a fixed catalog, scorer and limits.
Fake models prove plumbing, not live model quality. Live comparison must record provider, model, date and cost.
Checkpoint
uv run python scripts/tier3.py
uv run pytest tests/test_tier3.py -q
Audit the second fixture in capstones/02_security_audit.
04_tier_4
Tier 4 / Ecosystem
Compose services and negotiate extensions.
Tool design
Descriptions state scope, input constraints, effect and returned evidence.
Compare catalog size and task success before adding more tools.
An output schema validates structure; it does not prove factual accuracy.
Frameworks
Frameworks own orchestration; MCP owns the external capability boundary.
The TypeScript track runs Agents SDK, LangChain and LangGraph against one read-only workflow.
Keep model/runtime versions and approval policy explicit.
Gateway
Use fixed upstream aliases and collision-free names. Partition catalogs/caches by principal and scopes.
Recheck permissions at execution; limit rates and record redacted audit events.
A failed upstream should not silently expose hidden tools or block unrelated safe reads.
Tasks
Advertise io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks before accepting a task handle.
Poll tasks/get; answer input with tasks/update; cancel with tasks/cancel.
Persist ownership and expiry. Bound polling. A current Task handle is not the legacy SDK task shape.
Apps and Skills
Apps link a tool to a UI resource and a controlled bridge. Enforce browser sandbox/CSP and a narrow tool allowlist.
Skills are discovered and byte-verified before a separate activation decision. Origin plus URI identifies a skill.
Checkpoint
uv run python scripts/tier4.py
uv run python scripts/gateway_lab.py
Next: Gateway capstone and shipping modules 18-21.
05_tier_5
Tier 5 / Shipping
Install, deploy, operate and recover.
Packages
Build wheel/sdist, npm package and MCPB bundle from reviewed source. Inspect archive contents.
Launch installed packages outside the checkout; test uvx/npx and environment configuration.
Publication is separate from local packaging and requires the learner account.
Registry
Validate server.json against the pinned official schema and match package identity/version.
Verify namespace ownership before publishing. Registry metadata is discovery, not endorsement.
Review candidate endpoints and dependencies before installation or credential disclosure.
Remote operations
Use HTTPS externally, exact public resource URLs and configured trusted key endpoints.
Separate health/readiness from protected data; limit rates, bytes, runtime and costs.
Single-worker teaching state must become shared durable state before scaling out.
Production host
Bound connection attempts and calls. Retry only locally allowlisted reads; reconcile uncertain writes.
Refetch changed catalogs and revoke stale approvals.
Keep provider credentials server-side; isolate App frames and enforce their tool allowlist.
Run and teardown
uv run python scripts/package_lab.py --prepare
npm run build:chat; npm run test:browser
Use the documented Docker Compose stack; stop it afterward. Remove persistent volumes only intentionally.
Checkpoint
Prove installed launches, OAuth rejection, host approval/decline, Tasks and App isolation.
Finish Ops and Chat Pro capstones; review docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md.
06_protocol
Protocol / 2026-07-28
A compact message and trust reference.
Envelope
Request: jsonrpc="2.0", id, method, params. Response: same id with result or error.
Notification: method and params, no id and no response.
Client _meta: io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion, clientInfo, clientCapabilities.
Ten core request methods
server/discover; tools/list; tools/call
resources/list; resources/templates/list; resources/read
prompts/list; prompts/get; completion/complete; subscriptions/listen
Results and caching
complete: inspect application outcome, including isError on tool results.
input_required: collect input, echo protected requestState, retry with inputResponses.
Cacheable results carry ttlMs and cacheScope. Keep private caches partitioned by identity.
Notifications
Progress and cancellation are request-correlated. Subscription acknowledgment starts an event stream.
Resource update and tool/resource/prompt list-change events invalidate cached state.
Protocol logging remains deprecated optional vocabulary; prefer stderr or OpenTelemetry.
Extensions
Tasks: resultType=task; tasks/get, tasks/update, tasks/cancel.
Skills: skills/list, skills/get; resources/read verifies bytes; directory reads are optional.
Apps have a separate UI bridge. OAuth exchanges and Server Cards are HTTP metadata, not new JSON-RPC methods.
Failures and trust
-32601 unknown method; -32602 invalid params; -32020 HTTP metadata mismatch; -32021 missing capability; -32022 unsupported revision.
Descriptions and schemas do not grant permission. Verify identity, scopes, arguments and exact approval independently.
Full captured examples: docs/PROTOCOL_GUIDE.md.
